reviews.rationale: This records the bounded gate workflow validator, encoded-scalar rejection and shell-block boundary regressions. It changes no application behavior or provider state.

controls.request_bound: 0 application or provider requests are made by this review gate; git reads are bounded to 3000 changed files.
